title: Replace All ?'s to Avoid Consecutive Repeating Characters
description: Replace all '?' characters in a string such that no two consecutive characters are the same.

steps.note: Start loop at i=0, char is 'a'
Candidate 'a' fails (matches prev 'a'), candidate 'b' fails (matches next 'b'), pick 'c'
Loop finishes at i=2, char is 'b'
